title: Jennie's Heavenly Slow Cooker Chicken
description: Jennie's heavenly slow-cooker chicken recipe gently cooks chicken breasts in a cream cheese, mushroom soup, Italian dressing mix, and white wine sauce.
ingredients: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed golden mushroom soup
1 (8 ounce) container chive and onion cream cheese
1 (.7 ounce) package dry Italian-style salad dressing mix

steps.text: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat; stir in mushroom soup, cream cheese, wine, and salad dressing mix until hot, smooth, and combined.
Place chicken breasts in the bottom of a slow cooker; pour cream cheese sauce over top. Cover slow cooker. Cook on Low until chicken is tender, about 4 hours.

video.description: Watch how to make this heavenly chicken dish. The chicken breasts are cooked in a creamy mushroom and cheese sauce until perfectly tender. And because the cooking takes place in a slow cooker, you know it's going to be perfectly tender and still juicy. Serve over rice, pasta, or potatoes.
